sections.title: Sample Lawsuit Petition for Rejection of a Work Permit Application
sections.content:
A lawsuit may be filed against rejection of a work permit application using a sample lawsuit petition for rejection of a work permit application. Points to consider when completing the sample petition are set out both in the instructions within the petition and under the heading on points to consider below.

For more detailed information on this topic and to draft the petition more accurately, you may read our article on "lawsuit for rejection of a work permit application".

sections.title: Sample Lawsuit Petition for Rejection of a Work Permit Application
sections.content:
It should be remembered that the sample lawsuit petition for rejection of a work permit application below is only a draft. A tailored petition should be prepared taking into account the specific circumstances of each case. Procedural law rules must also be observed. Errors in procedural law may result in your claim being rejected even if you are substantively in the right. For this reason, obtaining legal support is advisable.

Sample Petition

…/…/…

TO THE …………… ON-DUTY ADMINISTRATIVE COURT

PLAINTIFF:  Name-Surname, Foreign Identity Number, Address

ATTORNEY:  Name-Surname, Bar Registration Number, Address, UETS Number

(Complete this section if you have an attorney)

DEFENDANT: Ministry of Family, Labour and Social Services (Directorate of International Labour)

SUBJECT: Request for stay of execution and subsequently cancellation of the work permit refusal decision.

NOTIFICATION DATE: …/…./….

STATEMENTS:

  1. Our client entered Türkiye through lawful means and first obtained a residence permit and then a work permit, thereby acquiring legal status. On the basis of this work permit, our client invested in our country with legal and legitimate capital brought from their country of origin and established the … company. A work permit was already in place at company formation and all remaining documents and required authorizations were obtained. (Attached documents may be reviewed.) However, the work permit application was incorrectly rejected by reference to a provision that does not align with our client's situation, without any justified reason.
  1. Approximately …… months later, thieves entered the workplace operated by our client, and our client's passport and a sum of money were stolen. Our client immediately applied to law enforcement and ensured the thief was apprehended in a short time. However, after this incident, our client was placed under administrative detention on the ground that they allegedly had no work permit, their residence permit was cancelled, and a deportation decision was issued.
  1. The decision rejecting our client's work permit request dated … and numbered … issued by the Ministry of Family, Labour and Social Services (Directorate General of International Labour) was issued in violation of Article 40 of the Constitution. The decision sent to our client by e-mail (attached) did not state the "remedy against the decision and the time limit for application", which must be included. Article 40 of the Constitution explains this situation as follows: "Everyone whose constitutional rights and freedoms are violated has the right to request that access to the competent authority be provided without delay. (Additional paragraph: 3/10/2001-4709/16.) The State, in its acts, must indicate which legal remedies and authorities the persons concerned may apply to and the time limits." The provision in the second paragraph of the cited article has been violated. Therefore, regardless of when the decision was issued on …, it cannot be said that the time limit for filing a lawsuit has expired for our client. We request that …, the date on which we learned orally as our client's attorney, be accepted as the notification date for the purpose of the lawsuit filing period.
  1. During this period, cancellation lawsuits were filed with the ….. Administrative Courts because the work permit cancellation, residence permit cancellation, and deportation decisions issued against our client are closely linked. However, as will be seen in decision no. ……… of Istanbul … Administrative Court, the court held that the lawsuits were separate in terms of jurisdiction and subject matter and issued a lack-of-jurisdiction decision. The decision was notified to us on … and, because our lawsuit filing period coincided with the judicial recess, we are filing suit again within the period in the competent court.
  1. The decision issued against our client is also unlawful in form. The decision against our client should have been issued in writing and notified in accordance with procedure. In its acts, the administration is as a rule subject to the written form requirement. Unless otherwise provided, administrative acts may not be notified to the person concerned by e-mail.
  1. The expression "written notification" in the Constitution and Law No. 2577 means that the act giving rise to the administrative dispute must be notified to the person concerned and that the person concerned must thereby be informed of the content of the act. In this context, such written notification is required for the administrative lawsuit filing period to begin.
  1. However, when the e-mail example we have additionally submitted to the file is examined, it is seen that the decision issued against our client was sent by e-mail. Notification by this method, which is not among official notification methods, is not compatible with the requirements of the legal process. For this reason, it must be assumed that the decision did not reach our client. In this case, the act issued defective in form and procedure must be annulled.
  1. The decision rejecting our client's work permit request is contrary to the "reason" element, one of the fundamental elements of an administrative act. In administrative law, "reason" is the legal or factual effect that leads the administration to take an administrative act.
  • The administration must state a reason when explaining the act it has taken. If the administration cannot show a valid reason when taking the act or the reason shown is not legally valid, the act is unlawful.
  • The administration may show any reason relating to the act it has taken. However, if the reason shown by the administration is legally erroneous, the act is unlawful.
  • In an act resulting from the administration's unilateral declaration of will, there may be a serious disproportion between the reason and subject elements. In this case too, the act is unlawful.
  1. The ground for rejection of our client's work permit application is neither clear nor based on a correct foundation. The rejection decision relates to Article 9A of Law No. 6735 on International Labour, which concerns foreign workers employed by an employer. However, our client operates their own workplace as an independent employer. Therefore, this decision issued against our client is invalid and must be annulled.
  1. The decision rejecting our client's work permit request also conflicts with the "purpose" element, another mandatory element of an administrative act. Opening a workplace with entirely legal and legitimate capital and the required authorizations benefits the Republic of Türkiye and society. Our client sets an example for compatriots coming from their country to Türkiye and complies with tax obligations. Therefore, the decision issued against our client is contrary to public order and must be annulled.

(The information in the ten paragraphs above must be completed according to the person's own situation and conditions)

  1. With cancellation of our client's work permit, our client has been deprived of a source of income and has been unable to work for approximately five to six months. For this reason, the request for legal aid must be accepted.
  1. Our client already had a work permit application and this application was made within the legal period. Therefore, before issuing a deportation or residence permit cancellation decision against our client, the administration should at least have awaited evaluation of the latest application.
  1. For these reasons, annulment of the administrative decisions concerning rejection of our client's work permit is requested.

LEGAL EVIDENCE: Work Permit Application Refusal Decision, Relevant E-mail, Work Permit Application Documents and other legal evidence

PRAYER FOR RELIEF: Your Honour, through this application, taking into account other elements to be considered ex officio, cancellation of the decision concerning rejection of the work permit application issued unjustly and unlawfully is requested, and it is respectfully requested that trial fees and expenses and attorney's fee be charged to the opposing party.(…../……../……)

NAME-SURNAME

SIGNATURE

sections.title: Points to Consider When Drafting a Sample Lawsuit Petition for Rejection of a Work Permit Application
sections.content:
• When completing the sample lawsuit petition for rejection of a work permit application, each case's specific circumstances must be taken into account.
  • The competent and authorized court must be correctly identified.
  • Mandatory elements required by law must be fully completed in the petition.
  • Evidence supporting each allegation must be stated in the legal evidence section.
  • When completing the sample petition, the matters requested in the prayer for relief section must be written completely and clearly.
  • Statutory limitation periods, limitation periods, and legal deadlines must be observed when filing and during the lawsuit.
  • If mediation is required before filing suit, mediation must be applied for first.
  • When filing suit or submitting an application, required court fees and expense advances must not be forgotten.

sections.title: Conclusion
sections.content: As can be seen, there are many points to consider when preparing a sample lawsuit petition for rejection of a work permit application. Deficiencies in these matters lead to loss of time and unnecessary costs. To prepare the petition correctly and manage the subsequent litigation process properly, it is advisable to obtain support from a specialist lawyer.

sections.title: На что обратить внимание при составлении образца искового заявления
sections.content:
• Учитывать особые обстоятельства каждого дела.
  • Правильно определить компетентный суд.
  • Заполнить обязательные элементы.
  • Указать доказательства.
  • Ясно сформулировать требования.
  • Соблюдать процессуальные сроки.
  • Обратиться к медиатору, если требуется.
  • Не забыть об уплате пошлин.

sections.title: Заключение
sections.content: При подготовке образца заявления необходимо учитывать множество моментов. Недостатки ведут к потере времени и лишним расходам. Целесообразно обратиться к специализированному адвокату.

sections.title: نمونه دادخواست رد درخواست مجوز کار
sections.content:
با نمونه دادخواست رد درخواست مجوز کار می‌توان علیه رد درخواست دعوا طرح کرد. نکات لازم در دستورالعمل داخل دادخواست و بخش زیر آمده است.

برای اطلاعات بیشتر مقاله «دعوای رد درخواست مجوز کار» را بخوانید.

sections.title: نمونه دادخواست رد درخواست مجوز کار
sections.content:
It should be remembered that the sample lawsuit petition for rejection of a work permit application below is only a draft. A tailored petition should be prepared taking into account the specific circumstances of each case. Procedural law rules must also be observed. Errors in procedural law may result in your claim being rejected even if you are substantively in the right. For this reason, obtaining legal support is advisable.

نمونه دادخواست

…/…/…

به …………… دادگاه اداری کشیک

خواهان:  Name-Surname, Foreign Identity Number, Address

وکیل:  Name-Surname, Bar Registration Number, Address, UETS Number

(Complete this section if you have an attorney)

خوانده: وزارت خانواده، کار و خدمات اجتماعی (Directorate of International Labour)

SUBJECT: Request for stay of execution and subsequently cancellation of the work permit refusal decision.

NOTIFICATION DATE: …/…./….

توضیحات:

  1. موکل ما entered Türkiye through lawful means and first obtained a residence permit and then a work permit, thereby acquiring legal status. On the basis of this work permit, our client invested in our country with legal and legitimate capital brought from their country of origin and established the … company. A work permit was already in place at company formation and all remaining documents and required authorizations were obtained. (Attached documents may be reviewed.) However, the work permit application was incorrectly rejected by reference to a provision that does not align with our client's situation, without any justified reason.
  1. Approximately …… months later, thieves entered the workplace operated by our client, and our client's passport and a sum of money were stolen. موکل ما immediately applied to law enforcement and ensured the thief was apprehended in a short time. However, after this incident, our client was placed under administrative detention on the ground that they allegedly had no work permit, their residence permit was cancelled, and a deportation decision was issued.
  1. The decision rejecting our client's work permit request dated … and numbered … issued by the وزارت خانواده، کار و خدمات اجتماعی (Directorate General of International Labour) was issued in violation of Article 40 of the Constitution. The decision sent to our client by e-mail (attached) did not state the "remedy against the decision and the time limit for application", which must be included. Article 40 of the Constitution explains this situation as follows: "Everyone whose constitutional rights and freedoms are violated has the right to request that access to the competent authority be provided without delay. (Additional paragraph: 3/10/2001-4709/16.) The State, in its acts, must indicate which legal remedies and authorities the persons concerned may apply to and the time limits." The provision in the second paragraph of the cited article has been violated. Therefore, regardless of when the decision was issued on …, it cannot be said that the time limit for filing a lawsuit has expired for our client. We request that …, the date on which we learned orally as our client's attorney, be accepted as the notification date for the purpose of the lawsuit filing period.
  1. During this period, cancellation lawsuits were filed with the ….. Administrative Courts because the work permit cancellation, residence permit cancellation, and deportation decisions issued against our client are closely linked. However, as will be seen in decision no. ……… of Istanbul … Administrative Court, the court held that the lawsuits were separate in terms of jurisdiction and subject matter and issued a lack-of-jurisdiction decision. The decision was notified to us on … and, because our lawsuit filing period coincided with the judicial recess, we are filing suit again within the period in the competent court.
  1. The decision issued against our client is also unlawful in form. The decision against our client should have been issued in writing and notified in accordance with procedure. In its acts, the administration is as a rule subject to the written form requirement. Unless otherwise provided, administrative acts may not be notified to the person concerned by e-mail.
  1. The expression "written notification" in the Constitution and Law No. 2577 means that the act giving rise to the administrative dispute must be notified to the person concerned and that the person concerned must thereby be informed of the content of the act. In this context, such written notification is required for the administrative lawsuit filing period to begin.
  1. However, when the e-mail example we have additionally submitted to the file is examined, it is seen that the decision issued against our client was sent by e-mail. Notification by this method, which is not among official notification methods, is not compatible with the requirements of the legal process. For this reason, it must be assumed that the decision did not reach our client. In this case, the act issued defective in form and procedure must be annulled.
  1. The decision rejecting our client's work permit request is contrary to the "reason" element, one of the fundamental elements of an administrative act. In administrative law, "reason" is the legal or factual effect that leads the administration to take an administrative act.
  • The administration must state a reason when explaining the act it has taken. If the administration cannot show a valid reason when taking the act or the reason shown is not legally valid, the act is unlawful.
  • The administration may show any reason relating to the act it has taken. However, if the reason shown by the administration is legally erroneous, the act is unlawful.
  • In an act resulting from the administration's unilateral declaration of will, there may be a serious disproportion between the reason and subject elements. In this case too, the act is unlawful.
  1. The ground for rejection of our client's work permit application is neither clear nor based on a correct foundation. The rejection decision relates to Article 9A of Law No. 6735 on International Labour, which concerns foreign workers employed by an employer. However, our client operates their own workplace as an independent employer. Therefore, this decision issued against our client is invalid and must be annulled.
  1. The decision rejecting our client's work permit request also conflicts with the "purpose" element, another mandatory element of an administrative act. Opening a workplace with entirely legal and legitimate capital and the required authorizations benefits the Republic of Türkiye and society. موکل ما sets an example for compatriots coming from their country to Türkiye and complies with tax obligations. Therefore, the decision issued against our client is contrary to public order and must be annulled.

(The information in the ten paragraphs above must be completed according to the person's own situation and conditions)

  1. With cancellation of our client's work permit, our client has been deprived of a source of income and has been unable to work for approximately five to six months. For this reason, the request for legal aid must be accepted.
  1. موکل ما already had a work permit application and this application was made within the legal period. Therefore, before issuing a deportation or residence permit cancellation decision against our client, the administration should at least have awaited evaluation of the latest application.
  1. For these reasons, annulment of the administrative decisions concerning rejection of our client's work permit is requested.

ادله حقوقی: Work Permit Application Refusal Decision, Relevant E-mail, Work Permit Application Documents and other legal evidence

خواسته: Your Honour, through this application, taking into account other elements to be considered ex officio, cancellation of the decision concerning rejection of the work permit application issued unjustly and unlawfully is requested, and it is respectfully requested that trial fees and expenses and attorney's fee be charged to the opposing party.(…../……../……)

نام-نام خانوادگی

امضا

sections.title: نکات مهم هنگام نگارش نمونه دادخواست رد درخواست مجوز کار
sections.content:
• شرایط ویژه هر پرونده.
  • تعیین دادگاه صالح.
  • تکمیل عناصر اجباری.
  • ذکر ادله.
  • نوشتن خواسته‌ها.
  • رعایت مهلت‌ها.
  • سازش در صورت اجبار.
  • پرداخت هزینه‌ها.

sections.title: نتیجه‌گیری
sections.content: نگارش نمونه دادخواست رد درخواست مجوز کار نکات زیادی دارد. کمبود موجب اتلاف وقت و هزینه می‌شود. حمایت وکیل متخصص توصیه می‌شود.
